incidents.summary: Bytes’ former CEO Neil Murphy conducted undisclosed share transactions between 2021 and 2023 and subsequently agreed to forfeit incentive entitlements and repay after-tax bonuses following the company’s investigation.

sources.title: 'Saddened and shocked': Bytes Technology launches probe into 100 secret dealings of former chief
sources.quote: A total of 119 unauthorised transactions took place on 66 trading days between January 2021 and November 2023.

sources.title: Outcome of investigation and notice of results | Company Announcement | Investegate
sources.quote: Mr Murphy has expressed profound regret for his failure to comply with regulations and the impact of his actions on both BTG and his former colleagues.

sources.title: Bytes Technology probe clears former CEO of misconduct in share trade | AJ Bell
sources.quote:
Bytes said it had reached a settlement with Murphy whereby he has agreed to forfeit his entitlements under its performance share plan and deferred donus plan in their entirety, and repay

his after-tax bonuses since the initial public offering on the London Stock Exchange in December 2020.
